content: Library code must never call sys.exit: it raises SystemExit which unwinds the caller and, if uncaught, kills the host process. Reserve sys.exit for the __main__ wrapper; library functions return values or raise domain exceptions. Do not print to stdout/stderr from library code - inject streams or return data and let the CLI adapter render. Keep parsing, network, file and env side effects out of module import time. argparse can be made non-exiting by overriding exit() and error() to raise instead.
